notes.title: A Heartfelt Update from the Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl Team
notes.notes:
We have some difficult news to share.

The Steam store page for Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl may be closing next week. Despite our best efforts, the game didn’t reach as many players as we had hoped. Unfortunately, the financial strain on our small team has made it impossible for us to continue supporting it in its current form.

To everyone who supported us, thank you, truly. Your enthusiasm, feedback, and kind words meant the world to us. We poured our hearts and efforts into this game, and your support made the journey worthwhile.

If you already own the game, we believe Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl will still be playable through Steam’s peer-to-peer online system. However, it will no longer be available for purchase.

This isn’t the end of our story. We may be down, but we’re not giving up easily. 
We’ll keep learning, creating, and we promise, we’ll be back... some day.

With love and gratitude,
The Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340928/2ad87dc99facf0b2834b4690770bdffb53e18fc0.png[/img]

notes.title: Update V1.1.1 Matchmaking & Versus Bots mode 🎉🎊✨
notes.notes:
Hi, Everyone! 🎈

We are thrilled to announce the release of [b]Update V1.1.1[/b] for [b]Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl[/b]! This major update brings exciting new features to elevate your party experience. Here’s what’s new: 🎮🪩💫

---
[b][h2]Update Main Menu[/h2][/b]
Changes:
[list]
[*]Add Session and Quick Play button
[*]Move the Host and Join button into Session Choice
[*]New Mode: Matchmaking and VS Bots in Quick Play Choice
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340928/f88989d79392f20f9d134b8f3778fe4410fe59cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340928/ee4485af2a0699d67011b439574127080c9cbbd8.png[/img]

[b][h2]New Matchmaking System[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340928/22fe4c53d1aae04e01c984b520edf6979a54813a.gif[/img]

We’ve completely revamped the matchmaking system to ensure faster queue times. If you come alone, don’t worry—the system will provide bots for matchmaking. You will never play alone. 🤖🎯💡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340928/8b6ebb64e936d968dc8b07b66e5918ad6e656e49.gif[/img]

[b][h2]New Versus Bot Mode[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340928/8922d7a3aae0ad405e07af32985716e57f38c19d.gif[/img]

Want to practice your moves or try out new strategies without the pressure of a live match? Introducing [b]Versus Bot Mode[/b]! Battling against AI opponents is perfect for honing your skills or just having fun at your own pace. 🛠️🤹‍♂️🎲

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340928/2db4d095014d6400b1654f2f2df18a1fa1dd5801.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Auto Zoom: Last Man Standing[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340928/a4fee8fd4ed3b2a92dc5dc088d03086ff9aae677.gif[/img]

Experience the thrill of the final moments like never before! At the end of each match, the camera will now automatically zoom in on the [b]Last Man Standing[/b], highlighting their victorious stance or final moments of glory. It’s the ultimate way to celebrate the star of the match! 🏆📸🎆

---

[b][h3]Update Your Game Now[/h3][/b]

The update is live and ready for download. Update your game today to explore these new features and make your [i]Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl[/i] experience even more festive and exciting! 🌟

Thank you for your continued support and feedback.

— The Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl Team 🌈✨🎈

notes.title: Holiday Party: Open Alpha Playtest Dec 15, 2023 - Jan 2, 2024
notes.notes:
Hi, Everyone!

Get ready for a jolly time because the [b]Holiday Party Open Alpha version is launching from December 15, 2023 - Jan 2, 2024![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340928/b0ba07a5f4c63342103d2940411f2d6961bbc4a2.png[/img]

We'd love to invite you and your friends to join our Open Alpha playtest. [b]Just simply click the "Playtest" button on our Steam page during these dates[/b]. For the ultimate fun, we recommend assembling a group of 4-8 players.

There are no restrictions or rules. Feel free to share, stream, or go live with your gameplay during the Open Alpha. However, if you prefer a more private experience, it's absolutely fine to just "play."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340928/f63f5b9791eb8674a1e55130737ea101278867e2.jpg[/img]

[b]If possible, please share your thoughts with us![/b] 
Click the feedback button in the main menu to access the feedback form or chat with us in Discord. 
https://discord.gg/XXWwJCpN3d

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340928/c9bea12222cda5872054f66f36218d13448f225e.jpg[/img]

Your insights are invaluable, and we can't wait to hear your thoughts on 'Holiday Party.' Your feedback will play a crucial role in making the game even more enjoyable for everyone. Please fill this form for us after the playtest: https://forms.gle/sH8NLUPbEbnZXieH8

Thank you for being part of the excitement and see you in Holiday Party!
